name: Hybrid Fourier-Hash Encoding
aliases: Geometry Representation with Fourier and Hash Encoding
Hybrid Fourier-Hash Encoding — Geometry Representation with Fourier and Hash Encoding, Hybrid Positional Encoding, Ours (full)
definition: A geometry representation technique that combines low-dimensional Fourier positional encoding with learnable hash features to improve the continuity of the signed distance function (SDF) and satisfy eikonal constraints, addressing the non-smooth solutions produced by hash encoding alone.
